name: MaSarADX
summary: This EA combines a 100-period Simple Moving Average, ADX directional indicators, and Parabolic SAR to identify and trade trend-following signals. It opens buy positions when price is above the MA, ADX+ is greater than ADX-, and price is above SAR; sell conditions are the mirror opposite. Positions are closed when price crosses back below/above the Parabolic SAR, and lot sizing is dynamically calculated based on account free margin and recent loss history.
summary_zh: 该EA结合100周期简单移动均线、ADX方向指标和抛物线SAR来识别趋势跟踪交易信号。当价格在MA上方、ADX+大于ADX-且价格在SAR上方时开多仓；做空条件相反。当价格反向穿越SAR时平仓，仓位根据账户可用保证金和近期亏损历史动态计算。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于三重确认的趋势跟踪系统，结合移动均线判断趋势方向、ADX判断趋势强度与方向、SAR作为跟踪止损和确认信号。入场条件方面，做多要求收盘价高于SMA(100)、ADX+线大于ADX-线且收盘价高于SAR值，三个条件同时满足才开仓；做空为镜像对称条件。出场条件仅依赖SAR反转信号——多头持仓时收盘价跌破SAR则平仓，空头持仓时收盘价涨破SAR则平仓，没有设置固定止损止盈。仓位管理采用基于账户可用保证金和最大风险比例的动态手数计算，并通过递减因子根据连续亏损次数缩减仓位，同时对交易量进行最小最大值和步长规范化。资金管理方面虽然考虑了风险比例和亏损递减，但开仓时止损止盈均为0，完全依赖SAR作为隐含跟踪止损，存在一定风险敞口。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为简单，缺乏对震荡行情的过滤机制和更完善的风险控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a triple-confirmation trend-following system combining a moving average for trend direction, ADX for trend strength and direction, and Parabolic SAR as a trailing stop and signal confirmation. For entry, a buy requires the close price above SMA(100), ADX+ greater than ADX-, and close above SAR—all three conditions must align simultaneously; sell conditions are the exact mirror. Exit relies solely on SAR reversal—long positions close when price falls below SAR, short positions close when price rises above SAR, with no fixed stop-loss or take-profit configured. Position sizing dynamically calculates lot size based on account free margin and a maximum risk percentage, then reduces size proportionally based on consecutive losing trades via a decrease factor, while normalizing volume to symbol step/min/max constraints. Although money management considers risk ratio and loss-based reduction, the PositionOpen call sets both stop-loss and take-profit to 0, relying entirely on SAR as an implicit trailing stop, which creates a meaningful risk exposure. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively simplistic, lacking a ranging-market filter and more robust risk controls.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 固定交易手数（未使用，实际采用动态计算）
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (unused; dynamic calculation applied)

parameters.name: MaximumRisk
parameters.description: 最大风险比例，用于动态手数计算
parameters.description_en: Maximum risk percentage for dynamic lot calculation

parameters.name: DecreaseFactor
parameters.description: 连续亏损后仓位递减因子
parameters.description_en: Position decrease factor after consecutive losses

pros: 三重确认机制（MA+ADX+SAR）减少虚假信号，入场条件严谨
动态仓位管理根据账户余额和连续亏损自适应调整，具有风险意识
使用新K线首笔报价检查避免重复交易，逻辑上实现一Bar一单
代码结构清晰，函数分工明确，易于理解和修改
pros_en: Triple confirmation (MA+ADX+SAR) reduces false signals with rigorous entry conditions
Dynamic position sizing adapts to account balance and consecutive losses, showing risk awareness
New bar first-tick check prevents repeated trading, effectively implementing one-trade-per-bar logic
Clean code structure with clear function separation, easy to understand and modify
cons: 开仓未设置止损止盈（均为0），完全依赖SAR平仓，极端行情下可能造成重大亏损
SAR参数硬编码为0.02/0.2，无法通过输入参数调整，缺乏灵活性
CheckForClose中未遍历所有持仓，仅处理单个选中持仓，多品种或多次开仓时可能遗漏
Lots输入参数声明但从未使用，容易造成用户困惑
缺乏震荡市过滤机制，ADX主线值未被用于判断趋势强弱
cons_en: No stop-loss or take-profit set on position open (both 0), relying entirely on SAR for exit—extreme moves could cause significant losses
SAR parameters are hardcoded (0.02/0.2) with no input parameter adjustment, lacking flexibility
CheckForClose doesn't iterate all positions, only processes a single selected position—multi-symbol or multiple positions may be missed
The Lots input parameter is declared but never used, which can confuse users
No ranging-market filter—the ADX main line value is not used to gauge trend strength for filtering
improvements: 将SAR参数改为可配置输入参数，并增加ADX主线阈值过滤震荡行情
为开仓添加止损止盈设置，结合ATR计算动态止损距离以增强风险控制
improvements_en: Make SAR parameters configurable inputs and add an ADX main line threshold filter to avoid trading in ranging markets
Add stop-loss and take-profit to position open calls, using ATR-based dynamic stop distances for enhanced risk control

risk_points: 开仓时止损止盈均为0，无硬性止损保护，闪崩或跳空行情可能造成远超预期的亏损
仅靠SAR反转平仓，在低波动或横盘行情中SAR频繁翻转可能导致连续亏损
CheckForClose未循环处理所有持仓，可能存在持仓无法被正确关闭的风险
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit are both 0 on open—no hard stop protection means flash crashes or gaps can cause losses far exceeding expectations
Relying solely on SAR reversal for exits can cause frequent whipsaw losses in low-volatility or sideways markets
CheckForClose doesn't loop through all positions, risking positions not being properly closed
